name: La Spezia (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Spezia (a tower on a mount beneath an eagle on blue).
history: Municipal flag of La Spezia, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: La Spezia arms — tower on a mount beneath an eagle on blue, crowned
